fields.original_request: Exact human text plus channel, chat id, message id, and timestamp. Immutable.
fields.council_interpretation: Versioned list. Does not replace original_request.
fields.authorization: principal id, telegram_user_id, build_authorized, authorized_by, events.
fields.execution_report_ref: Set after the executor writes a report.
fields.verification_report_ref: Set after the verifier writes a report.
fields.question_round: Count of question rounds. Cap is 3.
